title: Group email declarations: ghost
description:
Group the accepted positive email declarations in `ghost` into distinct data items and name each group. This needs a whole-repo view.

## Steps

- Input: the accepted email packets for the repo.
- Group declarations only when the source shows they hold the same data (assignment, a DTO passed through, a column read into a field, a relative import). Follow the component consolidation rules in `tests/eval/canonical-representation.md`: no grouping by name alone; ambiguous grouping stays `needs_adjudication`.
- Name each group by what the address is for and whose it is (for example "member account email", "newsletter sender address").
- Write `group` ids onto the records in a new packet and a `groups.yaml` with names and rationale.

## Done when

A person has accepted the groups.
